questions.goal: Averigua la dirección IP de la máquina infectada.
questions.hint: What is the IP address of the infected machine?

questions.goal: Averigua la IP del servidor de ficheros cuyos archivos se están cifrando.
questions.hint: What is the IP of the file server being encrypted?

questions.goal: Averigua a qué puerto del servidor de ficheros se conecta la máquina infectada.
questions.hint: What port did the infected machine connect to on the file server?

questions.goal: Averigua en qué frame empieza la conexión SMB entre la máquina infectada ({q1}) y el servidor de ficheros ({q2}).
questions.hint: The infected machine is {q1} and the file server is {q2}. What is the number of the first frame of the SMB (port {q3}) connection between them?

questions.goal: Averigua qué puerto de origen usa la máquina infectada en esa conexión (frame {q4}).
questions.hint: On the frame {q4}, the infected machine {q1} connects to the file server {q2} on destination port {q3}. What source port does the client use in that connection?
